title: فرافيرو فيت | مكمل غذائي لعلاج نقص الحديد
abstract:
Ferrero Vit is a dietary supplement consisting of 30 mg of iron pyrophosphate. Its liposomal form ensures optimal absorption through the duodenum and maximum bioavailability. The liposomal structure (phospholipid bilayers) protects iron molecules from being affected by stomach enzymes, acids, and food, improving iron absorption in the body without causing gastrointestinal discomfort or constipation.
### **Features of Ferrovero Vit Tablets:**  
- The liposomal technology masks the metallic taste of iron.
- Prevents stomach disturbances and reduces the risk of constipation.
- Primarily used to support iron levels in the body; can be chewed or swallowed.
- Helps treat iron deficiency anemia and enhances iron absorption.
### **Liposomal Iron (30 mg):**  
Helps treat iron deficiency anemia without the issues associated with traditional iron supplements and improves iron absorption.
